answer_1.quote: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) , which combine a visual encoder with a LLM, have achieved remarkable success in addressing various multimodal tasks.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates answers to visual questions and bounding box coordinates for referring expressions, which are forms of natural language generation.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the outputs of MLLMs by comparing them to ground truths in a word-by-word manner. Since tasks produce outputs in various formats, the evaluation metrics are tailored accordingly.
